description: Faithful Menon 2007 exact CPU optimization: contemporary paired public API measurements and a separate all-method table run.
interpretation: Compare before/after within paired_public_api. Separate all_methods_public_api used different competing method lanes and has different cache history; its absolute latencies should not replace the matched comparison.
All latency summaries are the arithmetic mean of RGGB and BGGR lane medians. Both experiments use the same unscaled top-left DIV2K0801 crop.
One worker was pinned to physical core16. Eight workers were pinned to physical cores16–23. Workers include the caller.
The before checkout is ad2eb36; source and binary SHA256 values identify both actual measured builds. No precision or algorithm approximation was applied.

Paths and compiler command arguments are normalized relative to the checkout. historical_observed_library_path records an original machine path only, not a portable input or artifact supplied in this repository.

Raw timings include Python/ctypes overhead, public wrapper padding/dispatch/final output stores, retained scratch, and synchronous host-to-host processing. No competing benchmark or corpus job was run on the selected cores.
reproduction: taskset -c 16-23 build/benchmark-venv/bin/python benchmark/compare_cpu.py --before build/cpu-before/build.json --before-root build/paper-before --after build/cpu-after/build.json --after-root . --check-small --output build/cpu-compare.json
